Java 17/21 JVM Compatibility Args Injection
nodes.rationale: Mojang version.json arguments.jvm omits module-access flags needed by Java 17+ (--add-modules=jdk.incubator.vector, --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED, and --sun-misc-unsafe-memory-access=allow for 21+); without them LWJGL throws IllegalAccessError. collect_args/java_compat_args inject them before -cp.
